messages:
Olivia G.: Notice on April Azure Marketplace invoice for reseller CloudGate — committed discount not applied to a set of seat SKUs. Can someone look?

Marc T.: invoice id?

Olivia G.: INV-2025-04-33421
Lines:
```
SKU: RG-STD-SEAT | qty=120 | unit_price=$12.00 | line_total=$1440.00
Discount: none applied
Expected after commit: unit_price=$9.60
```

Priya M.: looks like the partner commitment mapping (commit_id: COM-2025-01-99) wasn't linked on the Azure settlement side for seats provisioned via the reseller flow.

billing-bot: Sync job marketplace-azure-settlement v2025.04.01 ran. 4 partner_mappings failed to sync due to missing external_commit_id; retry scheduled.

Marc T.: can we patch invoice or issue credit? Policy: for missed committed discounts, we credit the delta for the invoice month and adjust future settlements.

Olivia G.: delta calculation: (12.00-9.60)*120 = $288.00. Please prepare CM and JE. Also need docs for Channel Ops and Accounting.

Priya M.: I'll fix mapping in settlement mapping table and run a targeted resync for CloudGate. Also creating ticket PARTNER-8801 for transparency.

billing-bot: Created ticket PARTNER-8801. Suggested action: issue CM-2025-04-305 for $288.00, update settlement mapping, run marketplace-azure-settlement resync. PR #901 in partner-sync repo.

Marc T.: drafting CM and JE. Will email accounting@redwood.com and cc channelops. ETA 1hr.

Olivia G.: please add a short partner note: "We applied the committed discount retroactively for April and adjusted settlement records; expect credit on next invoice if refund not available."

Priya M.: done. PR merged to patch mapping; resync queued. Monitoring logs for any other mislinked commits.

billing-bot: Resync completed: 4 items updated; 0 failures. Postmortem PM-2025-04-commit-link created. Owner Priya M.; due 2025-05-15.

Marc T.: accounting acked JE posting. CM issued. Channel Ops confirmed partner notified.

Olivia G.: closing loop here. Thanks everyone.

(END)
